name: Umshiza (Throwing Stick)
description: Traditional Swazi hardwood throwing stick used for hunting and combat

name: Ihawu (Cowhide Shield)
description: Cowhide war shield; black-and-white colouring denotes regiment seniority

name: Assegai (Spear)
description: Iron-tipped stabbing and throwing spear; primary Swazi infantry weapon

name: Calabash
description: Dried gourd vessel for water and beer; ubiquitous throughout the historical period

name: Flintlock Musket
description: European flintlock muskets reached Swaziland via Portuguese and Boer trade routes

name: Percussion Cap Rifle
description: Percussion rifles acquired by Swazi through cattle-and-ivory trade

name: Breech-Loading Rifle
description: Breech-loaders entered Swaziland during the concession period

name: Brass Bangles
description: Brass bangles via trade routes; status symbol during the colonial contact period

name: Colonial Concession Document
description: Paper concession granted to European settler or mining company; appeared post-1875

name: Incwala Ritual Emetic
description: Sacred mixture consumed during Incwala first-fruits ceremony; collected from royal waters
